title: Arm CSS for Mobile 2 delivers advanced AI-powered mobile experiences across the ecosystem
summary: Arm公司博客称，2026年9月推出的CSS for Mobile 2采用C2 CPU、SME2和Mali G2-Ultra NX，并称vivo、OPPO、小米及联发科等已采用；文中性能数据多为Arm内部测试或初步测试。
reason: 材料为Arm官方产品博客，含具体CPU/GPU IP、SME2、OEM与游戏引擎集成等事实，但性能多为厂商内部测试，独立验证不足；故给中等证据与行动评分。；存在待复核项
articleBody:
Blog
November 13, 2026

Arm CSS for Mobile 2 delivers advanced AI-powered mobile experiences across the ecosystem

Supported by growing adoption across silicon vendors, device manufacturers, and developers, the CPU and GPU technologies in CSS for Mobile 2 CPU are enabling faster on-device AI and more immersive mobile gaming experiences.

By Arm Editorial Team

Share

From more responsive on-device AI to cinematic gaming, the next generation of AI-powered mobile experiences is taking shape. Launched in September 2026, Arm CSS for Mobile 2 is the compute foundation for this new era of mobile AI. The AI-native compute platform combines the Arm C2 CPU cluster with Arm Scalable Matrix Extension 2 (SME2) and Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX, Arm’s first Mali GPU featuring Arm Neural Technology, along with Arm system technologies and software.

The Arm C2 Ultra CPU with SME2 brings a new level of responsive, efficient on-device AI to the CPU, while Mali G2-Ultra NX integrates dedicated neural accelerators that enable neural graphics to run natively on the GPU. These CPU and GPU technologies are already being adopted across the mobile ecosystem by leading OEMs, and game engines and studios, highlighting the platform’s ongoing momentum.

Highlights from the launch of CSS for Mobile 2 at Arm Everywhere China in September 2026

Bringing Arm’s latest CPU and GPU technologies to new mobile devices

The capabilities of the C2 CPU cluster and Mali G2-Ultra NX are coming to life on flagship smartphones built on MediaTek’s Dimensity 9600 Pro. vivo’s X500 Pro and Pro Max smartphones – the first Dimensity 9600 Pro-based flagship devices on the market – are designed to deliver multitasking and sophisticated agentic AI experiences. The OPPO Find X10 Pro Max brings faster performance and richer visuals to the Find X10 Series, which focuses on AI, photography, and gaming.

Separately, Xiaomi’s XRING O3 chipset brings Mali G2-Ultra NX graphics to the Xiaomi 18 Fold smartphone and Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max tablet.

It’s here. 📱 The new @oppo Find X10 Series has arrived.
 
Across the series, Arm technology helps power the performance and efficiency behind AI, photography and gaming experiences.
 
Leading the lineup, the Find X10 Pro Max pairs Arm C2 CPUs + Mali G2-Ultra NX graphics for… pic.twitter.com/KH4D4rNEIh

— Arm (@Arm) September 23, 2026

Congratulations to vivo on the new vivo X500 Pro Series! 🎉

Powered by @MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro, with 2x Arm C2-Ultra + 6x C2-Pro CPU cores and Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU, the X500 Pro brings next-gen performance and efficiency to OriginOS 7 — enabling seamless multitasking,… pic.twitter.com/rK5yX1UYDp

— Arm (@Arm) September 23, 2026

Mali G2-Ultra NX brings AI-native graphics to mobile gaming

Mali G2-Ultra NX is built for neural graphics from the ground up, with neural accelerators tightly integrated into the shader codes. This allows neural graphics workloads to run alongside graphics and compute workloads.

Mali G2-Ultra NX combines three neural technologies to deliver sharper graphics, smoother gameplay, and cinematic lighting within mobile power budgets:

Neural Super Sampling (NSS), which reconstructs higher-resolution images from lower-resolution renders, delivering sharper visuals with less rendering work.

Neural Frame Rate Upscaling (NFRU), which generates intermediate frames to increase frame rates and deliver smoother gameplay.

Neural Super Sampling and Denoising (NSSD), which combines neural upscaling with denoising to deliver cleaner, more detailed visuals in complex ray-traced scenes.

Players can experience these capabilities firsthand in Neural Dawn, co-developed by Arm and Sumo Digital. The game is now available to download and play on supported Android devices powered by Mali G2-Ultra NX, including those highlighted earlier. It is also the first mobile game featuring Unreal Engine MegaLights, bringing hundreds of dynamic lights and ray-traced shadows to mobile.

Experience Neural Dawn, showcasing how Arm Neural Technology, ray tracing, and Unreal Engine MegaLights are shaping the future of mobile gaming.

Meanwhile, leading game engines and studios are integrating Arm Neural Technology into their graphics pipelines, extending the progress beyond Neural Dawn.

Unity China’s Tuanjie Engine version 1.11.0 integrates NSS, giving developers access to neural graphics through an established engine and reducing the need for custom implementations. To date, the Tuanjie Engine has already surpassed 1.9 million cumulative downloads, laying a strong foundation for the broader adoption of Arm Neural Technology.

Infold Games is integrating NSS into Infinity Nikki, which has surpassed 20 million downloads worldwide.

The MagicDawn team at Tencent Games Central Tech is integrating Arm Neural Technology into its MagicDawn rendering technology.

A NSSD demonstration in Arena Breakout Infinite, which has attracted more than 66,000 concurrent players on Steam, showcases how AI-assisted graphics can support sophisticated game content.

NetEase is bringing Arm Neural Technology to players through its Where Winds Meet game, which is a Gamescom Best Mobile Game award winner.

SME2 is accelerating AI experiences on mobile

Through SME2 in CSS for Mobile 2, the performance of agentic AI workloads is improving by up to 70% compared to the previous generation. Leading smartphone vendors like OPPO and vivo are using SME2 to accelerate on-device AI workloads. Google is helping developers use SME2 through its AI Edge software stack, where LiteRT, XNNPACK, and Arm KleidiAI enable automatic CPU acceleration on supported mobile devices.

Google’s Oli Gaymond explores how Arm technology is powering the shift toward responsive, on-device agentic AI experiences.

Internal Arm testing shows how SME2 delivers significant performance gains when running AI workloads on Google’s Gemma 4 E2B model, including an average of 5.5x speedup in prefill (processing user input) and up to 1.6x faster decoding (generating responses). Users can explore SME2-accelerated on-device AI through Google AI Edge Gallery, an application that runs Gemma models locally, and leverages SME2 acceleration on supported devices.

Other collaborations on SME2 include:

Arm and Tencent Media Lab working together to use SME2 to accelerate neural image decoding, cutting processing time for a 2K image from 61ms to 30ms on a reference smartphone using just two CPU threads. This enables faster, more responsive image processing on mobile devices.

Liquid AI using SME2 to accelerate the performance of its new LFM3 models, with early, provisional tests showing 3.1x faster prefill and 1.5x faster decoding for LFM3-1.7B using two CPU threads. This helps AI-based applications process inputs and generate responses faster, improving responsiveness for on-device AI.

Studio Atelico using SME2 to bring the Bobium Brawlers game to Android, with this enabling faster, more responsive experiences for players through AI that runs entirely on mobile devices.

Building momentum for the next generation of mobile experiences

The momentum behind CSS for Mobile 2 is taking shape across the mobile ecosystem. OPPO and vivo are bringing Arm CPU and GPU technologies into commercial mobile devices. Meanwhile, Xiaomi is extending the reach of Mali G2-Ultra NX across smartphones and tablets.

These hardware innovations are translating into enhanced real-world experiences, with the software ecosystem taking advantage of the advanced compute capabilities. Game engine and studio integrations, and playable demonstrations like Neural Dawn give developers more ways to harness neural graphics, and deliver richer, more cinematic mobile gaming experiences. And the growing adoption and integration of SME2 enables faster, more responsive AI experiences across mobile applications.

As these mobile technologies reach more devices and development environments, Arm is laying the foundation for more sophisticated on-device AI, advanced graphics, and increasingly immersive and responsive mobile experiences.

Enabling AI-native mobile experiences at the edge

Arm CSS for Mobile 2 provides the foundation for the next generation of AI-native mobile experiences, from agentic AI to neural graphics.

Learn more

By Arm Editorial Team

blocks.text: Arm CSS for Mobile 2 在整个生态系统中带来先进的 AI 驱动移动体验
在芯片厂商、设备制造商和开发者日益增长的采用支持下，CSS for Mobile 2 CPU 中的 CPU 和 GPU 技术正在实现更快的端侧 AI 和更具沉浸感的移动游戏体验。

blocks.alt: Arm CSS for Mobile 2

blocks.text: 从更灵敏的端侧 AI 到电影级游戏体验，下一代 AI 驱动的移动体验正在成形。Arm CSS for Mobile 2 于 September 2026 发布，是这一移动 AI 新时代的计算基础。该 AI 原生计算平台将 Arm C2 CPU 集群与 Arm Scalable Matrix Extension 2 (SME2) 和 Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX（Arm 首款采用 Arm Neural Technology 的 Mali GPU）以及 Arm 系统技术和软件相结合。
搭载 SME2 的 Arm C2 Ultra CPU 为 CPU 带来全新水平的响应迅速、高效的端侧 AI，而 Mali G2-Ultra NX 集成了专用神经加速器，使神经图形能够在 GPU 上原生运行。这些 CPU 和 GPU 技术已被领先 OEM 以及游戏引擎和工作室在整个移动生态系统中采用，凸显了该平台持续的势头。
将 Arm 最新 CPU 和 GPU 技术引入新的移动设备

C2 CPU 集群和 Mali G2-Ultra NX 的能力正在基于 MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro 打造的旗舰智能手机上变为现实。vivo 的 X500 Pro 和 Pro Max 智能手机——市场上首批基于 Dimensity 9600 Pro 的旗舰设备——旨在提供多任务处理和先进的智能体 AI 体验。OPPO Find X10 Pro Max 为聚焦 AI、摄影和游戏的 Find X10 系列带来更快的性能和更丰富的视觉体验。
另外，小米的 XRING O3 芯片组将 Mali G2-Ultra NX 图形技术引入 Xiaomi 18 Fold 智能手机和 Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max 平板电脑。

它来了。📱 全新的 @oppo Find X10 系列已登场。
 
在整个系列中，Arm 技术助力为 AI、摄影和游戏体验背后的性能与能效提供支持。
 
作为该系列的领衔机型，Find X10 Pro Max 将 Arm C2 CPU + Mali G2-Ultra NX 图形技术相结合，用于… pic.twitter.com/KH4D4rNEIh

祝贺 vivo 推出全新的 vivo X500 Pro 系列！🎉

X500 Pro 搭载 @MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro，配备 2x Arm C2-Ultra + 6x C2-Pro CPU 核心以及 Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU，为 OriginOS 7 带来新一代性能与能效——实现无缝多任务处理，… pic.twitter.com/rK5yX1UYDp
Mali G2-Ultra NX 将 AI 原生图形引入移动游戏
Mali G2-Ultra NX 从底层为神经图形而打造，神经加速器紧密集成到着色器代码中。这使得神经图形工作负载能够与图形和计算工作负载并行运行。
Mali G2-Ultra NX 融合三项神经技术，在移动功耗预算内提供更锐利的图形、更流畅的游戏体验和电影级光照：

items: 神经超级采样（NSS），它从较低分辨率的渲染重建更高分辨率的图像，以更少的渲染工作量提供更锐利的视觉效果。
神经帧率提升（NFRU），它生成中间帧以提高帧率并带来更流畅的游戏体验。
神经超级采样与降噪（NSSD），它将神经放大与降噪相结合，在复杂的光线追踪场景中提供更干净、更细致的视觉效果。

blocks.text: 玩家可以在由 Arm 与 Sumo Digital 联合开发的 Neural Dawn 中亲身体验这些能力。该游戏现已可在搭载 Mali G2-Ultra NX 的支持 Android 设备上下载并游玩，包括前文提到的设备。它也是首款采用 Unreal Engine MegaLights 的移动游戏，将数百个动态光源和光线追踪阴影带到移动端。
与此同时，领先的游戏引擎和工作室正在将 Arm Neural Technology 集成到其图形管线中，将进展扩展到 Neural Dawn 之外。

items: Unity 中国的 Tuanjie Engine 1.11.0 版本集成了 NSS，使开发者能够通过成熟引擎使用神经图形，并减少对自定义实现的需求。迄今为止，Tuanjie Engine 的累计下载量已超过 190 万次，为 Arm Neural Technology 的更广泛采用奠定了坚实基础。
Infold Games 正在将 NSS 集成到 Infinity Nikki 中，该游戏全球下载量已超过 2000 万次。
腾讯游戏 Central Tech 的 MagicDawn 团队正在将 Arm Neural Technology 集成到其 MagicDawn 渲染技术中。
Arena Breakout Infinite 中的 NSSD 演示在 Steam 上已吸引超过 66,000 名同时在线玩家，展示了 AI 辅助图形如何支持复杂游戏内容。
网易正在通过其游戏 Where Winds Meet 将 Arm Neural Technology 带给玩家，该游戏曾获 Gamescom 最佳移动游戏奖。

blocks.text: SME2 正在加速移动端 AI 体验
通过 CSS for Mobile 2 中的 SME2，智能体 AI 工作负载的性能相较上一代提升最高可达 70%。OPPO 和 vivo 等领先智能手机厂商正在使用 SME2 加速端侧 AI 工作负载。Google 正通过其 AI Edge 软件栈帮助开发者使用 SME2，其中 LiteRT、XNNPACK 和 Arm KleidiAI 可在受支持的移动设备上实现自动 CPU 加速。
Arm 内部测试显示，在 Google 的 Gemma 4 E2B 模型上运行 AI 工作负载时，SME2 可带来显著性能提升，其中预填充（处理用户输入）平均加速 5.5 倍，解码（生成响应）最高提速 1.6 倍。用户可通过 Google AI Edge Gallery 探索由 SME2 加速的端侧 AI；该应用在本地运行 Gemma 模型，并在受支持的设备上利用 SME2 加速。

Arm CSS for Mobile 2 在整个生态系统中带来先进的 AI 驱动移动体验

在芯片厂商、设备制造商和开发者日益增长的采用支持下，CSS for Mobile 2 CPU 中的 CPU 和 GPU 技术正在实现更快的端侧 AI 和更具沉浸感的移动游戏体验。

作者：Arm 编辑团队

分享

从更灵敏的端侧 AI 到电影级游戏体验，下一代 AI 驱动的移动体验正在成形。Arm CSS for Mobile 2 于 September 2026 发布，是这一移动 AI 新时代的计算基础。该 AI 原生计算平台将 Arm C2 CPU 集群与 Arm Scalable Matrix Extension 2 (SME2) 和 Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX（Arm 首款采用 Arm Neural Technology 的 Mali GPU）以及 Arm 系统技术和软件相结合。

搭载 SME2 的 Arm C2 Ultra CPU 为 CPU 带来全新水平的响应迅速、高效的端侧 AI，而 Mali G2-Ultra NX 集成了专用神经加速器，使神经图形能够在 GPU 上原生运行。这些 CPU 和 GPU 技术已被领先 OEM 以及游戏引擎和工作室在整个移动生态系统中采用，凸显了该平台持续的势头。

将 Arm 最新 CPU 和 GPU 技术引入新的移动设备

C2 CPU 集群和 Mali G2-Ultra NX 的能力正在基于 MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro 打造的旗舰智能手机上变为现实。vivo 的 X500 Pro 和 Pro Max 智能手机——市场上首批基于 Dimensity 9600 Pro 的旗舰设备——旨在提供多任务处理和先进的智能体 AI 体验。OPPO Find X10 Pro Max 为聚焦 AI、摄影和游戏的 Find X10 系列带来更快的性能和更丰富的视觉体验。

另外，小米的 XRING O3 芯片组将 Mali G2-Ultra NX 图形技术引入 Xiaomi 18 Fold 智能手机和 Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max 平板电脑。

Mali G2-Ultra NX 将 AI 原生图形引入移动游戏

Mali G2-Ultra NX 从底层为神经图形而打造，神经加速器紧密集成到着色器代码中。这使得神经图形工作负载能够与图形和计算工作负载并行运行。

Mali G2-Ultra NX 融合三项神经技术，在移动功耗预算内提供更锐利的图形、更流畅的游戏体验和电影级光照：

神经超级采样（NSS），它从较低分辨率的渲染重建更高分辨率的图像，以更少的渲染工作量提供更锐利的视觉效果。

神经帧率提升（NFRU），它生成中间帧以提高帧率并带来更流畅的游戏体验。

神经超级采样与降噪（NSSD），它将神经放大与降噪相结合，在复杂的光线追踪场景中提供更干净、更细致的视觉效果。

玩家可以在由 Arm 与 Sumo Digital 联合开发的 Neural Dawn 中亲身体验这些能力。该游戏现已可在搭载 Mali G2-Ultra NX 的支持 Android 设备上下载并游玩，包括前文提到的设备。它也是首款采用 Unreal Engine MegaLights 的移动游戏，将数百个动态光源和光线追踪阴影带到移动端。

与此同时，领先的游戏引擎和工作室正在将 Arm Neural Technology 集成到其图形管线中，将进展扩展到 Neural Dawn 之外。

Unity 中国的 Tuanjie Engine 1.11.0 版本集成了 NSS，使开发者能够通过成熟引擎使用神经图形，并减少对自定义实现的需求。迄今为止，Tuanjie Engine 的累计下载量已超过 190 万次，为 Arm Neural Technology 的更广泛采用奠定了坚实基础。

Infold Games 正在将 NSS 集成到 Infinity Nikki 中，该游戏全球下载量已超过 2000 万次。

腾讯游戏 Central Tech 的 MagicDawn 团队正在将 Arm Neural Technology 集成到其 MagicDawn 渲染技术中。

Arena Breakout Infinite 中的 NSSD 演示在 Steam 上已吸引超过 66,000 名同时在线玩家，展示了 AI 辅助图形如何支持复杂游戏内容。

网易正在通过其游戏 Where Winds Meet 将 Arm Neural Technology 带给玩家，该游戏曾获 Gamescom 最佳移动游戏奖。
